primary_hypothesis: Never-equal counts based only on jointly given cells recover all and only the 810 true peer edges at N=3000 in all six fixed nested banks.
primary_decision: Supported on these six banks iff every N3000 clue-only support equals the peer graph exactly. Falsified if any bank differs. This is a finite-bank result, not a population guarantee.
pool_provenance: Prior source-hashed exhaustive pass found all 3831994 answer strings distinct. Reuse that proof after source hash verification; source row and pool index coincide.
sampling: NumPy 2.3.4 default_rng(20261116+seed).permutation(3831994)[:3000]. First1000 rows, completions and masks must byte-match the prior raw banks. Nested prefixes; record cross-bank overlap.
mask_policy: Use original associated question mask. Clue-only files have observed values in 0..8, missing=-1, given mask and source row; no solution arrays. Full completions in separate positive-control files.
estimator: Retain pair(i,j) iff no selected row has given[i] and given[j] and value[i]==value[j]. Estimator receives clue-only files; full controls use complete solutions. No augmentation, optimization or geometry in support construction.
leakage_gates: For every prefix, replacing all hidden entries by a sentinel, fixed random digits, or shuffled observed digits must leave support byte-identical. Empty observed mask must retain every pair. First save and hash all supports, then run geometry audit.
search: Unit1 equal-digit pair penalties, B0, tau0, ebar0; do not call prepare or solution_stats on hidden completions. Temperature .4 to .31 over 524288 moves; focus .45; four chains; seed=bank seed; check4096; cap262144; tol.001.
secondary_hypothesis: Clue-only N3000 accuracy is noninferior within 2 percentage points to its full-completion control on the fixed test cohort.
secondary_decision: Paired two-way bootstrap over six bank/search seeds and 10000 shared puzzles, 5000 draws, RNG20261118. Supported if 95% CI lower bound>=-2pp; falsified if upper bound<-2pp; otherwise inconclusive. N300 contrast descriptive only.
deduplication: Reuse inference only if support bytes, zero B, literal unit/tau/ebar, full search settings, test data and seed are identical. Save each requested model-to-canonical-job mapping. Different seeds remain distinct.
oracle_audit: Compute target energies and Sudoku geometry only after fixed supports. Target E0 is a ceiling for correct certified stops only, not all returned-board accuracy. No feedback.
validation: Audit source masks, all support/count rules, invariance, nested monotonicity, train-test full-board overlap, artifact hashes, general/sparse parity before each unique search, and every returned board independently.
limitations: Official questions were generated from Sudoku and their masks can be biased. Six fixed banks do not establish distribution-free sample complexity.
The clues-only estimator knows the cell and digit alphabet, equal-digit repulsion and a zero-energy stopping rule. It does not receive row, column or box geometry.
The preserved official test solutions are available to the search API for scoring and clue initialization; hidden targets do not set energies or move selection.
BP AdamW is outside this count-only mechanism study and is not run.
